'''Baron Deathmark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] announcer for the [[Huttball/Legends|Huttball]] games played by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] between [[3643 BBY]] and [[3630 BBY]]. At some point, he commentated on a match between the [[Frog-dogs]] and the [[Rotworms]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Baron Deathmark was voiced by [[Steve Blum|Steven Jay Blum]] for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
